# Cyanosis theme source

- Source: <https://github.com/linxsbox/juejin-markdown-theme-cyanosis>
- Pinned commit: `6b814ea`
- Upstream file: `cyanosis.scss`
- Upstream theme license: MIT
- Registered in juejin-markdown-themes as `cyanosis` (highlight: atom-one-dark)

`cyanosis.scss` is an unmodified source snapshot retained for local comparison
and traceability. It is not included in WeiSome application resources or
packages.

WeiSome adapts only article-content rules to Compose preview styles and inline
HTML export. The hr's centered scissors ornament (`hr::after` PNG image) and
the selection, `details`/`summary`, task-list checkbox styling, and table row
hover styles are pseudo-element or interactive effects the inline-CSS model
cannot express. Code-block colors continue to come from WeiSome's selected
code theme.
